content.text:
I can't answer this from data, because the working directory has none. It has only empty placeholder files (shell and editor config such as `.bashrc` and `.mcp.json`) and a `.claude` folder. There are no IURC orders, no extracted case records and no dataset covering the 58 orders from 2021 through 2025. The directory isn't a git repository either. I didn't look outside it, since I'm limited to files in the working directory.

So I can't give counts of cases for 2021, 2022, 2023, 2024 and 2025, and I can't say which year has the most. Any figures I gave would be invented, not an estimate grounded in evidence.

If you add the order documents (PDFs or text) or a table of the extracted cases, I can count cases per year by order date and name the peak year.
